rationale: S-0053-02 proposes a stricter centripetal-gating threshold sweep (cos < -0.3, -0.5, -0.7, -0.866) to halve the active-fraction on t0053. t0057 already demonstrated that the active-fraction modulation (0.34-0.66 across directions) is intact and that the failure mode is amplitude-driven (single-spike below 1.5 nS, full suppression at/above), not gating-geometry-driven. The AMPA escape and bar-locked-window axes (t0059) are higher-leverage. Reprioritising from high to medium.
